notes: Qty 59 as published (the section headers also add up to 59).
Section headers 'Purple (2)' (Objective + Epic Event) and 'Blue (8)' (starships and vehicles) are card-type labels, not cards.

Starting cards as posted under 'Start': the Objective (posted 'HDADTJ'), Executor: Holotheatre, Executor: Meditation Chamber, Visage Of The Emperor, Prepared Defenses, Imperial Arrest Order, Mobilization Points and Oppressive Enforcement; several Effects start, so no single starting Effect is set.

Posted 'CC Platform 327 (Docking Bay)' dested the Dark Cloud City docking bay, Cloud City: East Platform (Docking Bay) (Platform 327 is the Light card). 'ECC IG-88' dested IG-88 With Riot Gun and 'EJP Dengar' Dengar With Blaster Carbine (the Enhanced Cloud City / Enhanced Jabba's Palace cards); 'Zuckuss In Hunter' Zuckuss In Mist Hunter; 'Dreadnaught' Dreadnaught-Class Heavy Cruiser; 'Maras Lightsaber' Mara Jade's Lightsaber.
Oppressive Enforcement is the Special Edition Effect (not the later Defensive Shield). The 'CARDS I WANT TO ADD' list and the author's mention of a heavily modified version are not applied.
